title: Prospective Cohort Study With Central Nervous System Evaluation in Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma
brief_summary: This study is to evaluate the incidence of central nervous system (CNS) relapse or metastasis in patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Newly diagnosed patients with diffuse large B cell lymphoma
2. \> 20 years
3. life expectancy more than 6 months
4. Written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Refusal to informed consent
2. Lymphomas other than diffuse large B cell lymphoma
3. Primary CNS lymphoma
